---
title: "Market Board"
subtitle: "Interactive for Lecture 14: the classroom market experiment"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

<!-- Runs in the browser, no server. The card schedule is
market-data.json beside this file, written by slides/figures/make_lecture14.py,
so the board, the cards, and the deck agree. If market-results.json sits
beside the page (exported from the board after class), a visitor with no
saved state sees that class's results with a note; "Clear everything" gives
a blank board. The top of the page is used
live while a round runs: the instructor enters each trade as the buyer's
value, the seller's cost, and the price, and the page shows the trade
count, the average price, and every price in order. The outcome section
at the bottom, folded shut until opened, takes the numbers on the cards
that did not trade; the cards in play are those plus the traded ones, and
it draws supply and demand from them with the round's trades on top, and shows the
clearing band and each trade's earnings. Rounds repeat with the same
cards reshuffled, as many as the class has time for. Trades are kept in
localStorage so a reload during class loses nothing; every read and write
is wrapped, so the page also works with storage blocked. Colours: demand
#0072B2 (text #005f94), supply #8f4100, each 4.5:1 or better on white;
rounds differ by marker shape and label, not colour alone. -->

```{=html}
<style>
.mb-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(9rem, 1fr)); gap: 0.6rem 1rem; align-items: end; margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem; max-width: 60rem; }
.mb-grid label { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.mb-grid input[type=number], .mb-grid input[type=text], .mb-grid select { width: 100%; height: 2.8rem; font-size: 1.25rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.4rem; border: 1px solid #747576; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; box-sizing: border-box; }
.mb-buyer { color: #005f94; }
.mb-seller { color: #8f4100; }
.mb-grid select.mb-buyer { border-color: #0072B2; border-width: 2px; }
.mb-grid select.mb-seller { border-color: #BF5700; border-width: 2px; }
.mb-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0.4rem 0 0.4rem; }
.mb-actions button { font-size: 1.1rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #8f4100; background: #8f4100; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; }
.mb-actions button.mb-quiet { background: #fff; color: #8f4100; }
.mb-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1a1a1a; outline-offset: 2px; }
.mb-note { background: #FDF3EA; border-left: 5px solid #BF5700; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; font-size: 1.05rem; max-width: 60rem; }
.mb-msg { min-height: 2.6rem; font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #8f4100; margin: 0.2rem 0 0.4rem; }
.mb-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(14rem, 1fr)); gap: 0.75rem 1.25rem; margin: 0.2rem 0 0.8rem; max-width: 60rem; }
.mb-summary div { background: #FDF3EA; border-left: 5px solid #BF5700; padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem; }
.mb-summary b { display: inline; font-size: 1.9rem; line-height: 1.1; color: #1a1a1a; margin-right: 0.5rem; }
.mb-summary span { color: #1a1a1a; font-size: 1.2rem; }
.mb-summary-outcome { display: block; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.mb-stats { width: 100%; max-width: 44rem; table-layout: fixed; margin: 0.25rem auto 0.5rem; }
details.mb-cards { max-width: 60rem; margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem; }
details.mb-cards summary { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #8f4100; cursor: pointer; padding: 0.3rem 0; text-align: center; }
details.mb-cards summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1a1a1a; outline-offset: 2px; }
.mb-stats th, .mb-stats td { text-align: center !important; padding: 4px 14px; font-size: 1.15rem; min-width: 8rem; }
.mb-stats th[scope=row] { text-align: left !important; font-weight: 600; }
.mb-table tr.mb-out td { color: #595a5b; }
.mb-table caption { caption-side: bottom; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #393A3B; }
.mb-chart { width: 100%; max-width: 60rem; margin: 0.5rem 0; }

.mb-untraded { margin-top: 2rem; }
.mb-chart svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; font-family: inherit; }
.mb-table { overflow-x: auto; max-width: 100%; }
.mb-table table { width: 100%; max-width: 28rem; table-layout: fixed; margin: 0.25rem auto 0.5rem; }
.mb-table p { text-align: center; }
.mb-table td, .mb-table th { text-align: center !important; padding: 4px 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.mb-table th:first-child, .mb-table td:first-child { width: 2.5rem; }
details.mb-debrief { margin-top: 1.5rem; border-top: 2px solid #BF5700; padding-top: 0.5rem; }
details.mb-debrief summary { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: #8f4100; cursor: pointer; padding: 0.4rem 0; }
details.mb-debrief summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1a1a1a; outline-offset: 2px; }
#mb-dealt-note { color: #393A3B; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .mb-summary b { font-size: 1.2rem; } }
</style>

<p id="mb-note" class="mb-note" hidden></p>

<div class="mb-grid" role="group" aria-label="Report a trade">
  <div><label for="mb-round">Round</label><select id="mb-round"><option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4">4</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="6">6</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="mb-b" class="mb-buyer">Buyer's value</label><select id="mb-b" class="mb-buyer"><option value="">–</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="mb-s" class="mb-seller">Seller's cost</label><select id="mb-s" class="mb-seller"><option value="">–</option></select></div>
  <div><label for="mb-p">Price</label><input id="mb-p" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" inputmode="decimal"></div>
</div>
<div class="mb-actions">
  <button id="mb-add" type="button">Add trade</button>
  <button id="mb-undo" type="button" class="mb-quiet">Undo last</button>
  <button id="mb-clear-round" type="button" class="mb-quiet">Clear this round</button>
  <button id="mb-clear" type="button" class="mb-quiet">Clear everything</button>
</div>
<p id="mb-msg" class="mb-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>

<div id="mb-summary" class="mb-summary" aria-live="polite"></div>

<figure class="mb-chart">
  <div id="mb-svg"></div>
  <figcaption id="mb-cap"></figcaption>
</figure>

<div class="mb-grid mb-untraded" role="group" aria-label="Cards that did not trade">
  <div><label for="mb-ub" class="mb-buyer">Buyer values that did not trade</label><input id="mb-ub" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" placeholder="e.g. 7, 4, 4"></div>
  <div><label for="mb-us" class="mb-seller">Seller costs that did not trade</label><input id="mb-us" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" placeholder="e.g. 4, 8, 8"></div>
</div>
<small id="mb-dealt-note"></small>
<div class="mb-actions">
  <button id="mb-csv" type="button" class="mb-quiet">Download all trades (CSV)</button>
  <button id="mb-json" type="button" class="mb-quiet">Export results (JSON)</button>
</div>

<details class="mb-debrief" id="mb-debrief">
  <summary>Outcome</summary>
  <div id="mb-summary2" class="mb-summary mb-summary-outcome"></div>
  <figure class="mb-chart">
    <div id="mb-svg2"></div>
    <figcaption id="mb-cap2"></figcaption>
  </figure>
  <details class="mb-cards">
    <summary>The cards behind the curves</summary>
    <div class="mb-table" tabindex="0" id="mb-table"></div>
  </details>
</details>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  const DATA_URL = "market-data.json";
  const KEY = "econ201-market-board-v2";   // bumped when the saved shape changes
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  let data = null;
  let trades = []; // {round, v, c, p}: buyer's value, seller's cost, price

  const count = (arr, x) => arr.filter((y) => y === x).length;
  const round = () => +$("mb-round").value;
  const cur = () => trades.filter((t) => t.round === round());
  // Cards that did not trade, typed in at the end of each round: {round: {b, s}}.
  let untraded = {};
  const parse = (s) => s.split(/[\s,;]+/).filter((x) => x !== "").map(Number).filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x) && x >= 0);
  const untradedB = () => parse((untraded[round()] || {}).b || "");
  const untradedS = () => parse((untraded[round()] || {}).s || "");
  // Cards in play this round: the traded ones plus the untraded ones.
  const dealtB = () => cur().map((t) => t.v).concat(untradedB());
  const dealtS = () => cur().map((t) => t.c).concat(untradedS());

  function showUntraded() {
    const u = untraded[round()] || {};
    $("mb-ub").value = u.b || ""; $("mb-us").value = u.s || "";
  }
  function applyState(t) {
    // Keep only well-formed trades, so state saved by an older version cannot break the page.
    trades = (t.trades || []).filter((x) => x && [x.round, x.v, x.c, x.p].every((n) => Number.isFinite(n)));
    $("mb-round").value = t.round || "1";
    untraded = (t.untraded && typeof t.untraded === "object") ? t.untraded : {};
  }
  function load(results) {
    let t = null;
    try { t = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || "null"); } catch (e) {}
    if (t && Array.isArray(t.trades)) {
      applyState(t);
    } else if (results && Array.isArray(results.trades)) {
      // Nothing saved in this browser: show the published results from class.
      applyState(results);
      if (results.label) { $("mb-note").textContent = results.label; $("mb-note").hidden = false; }
    }
    showUntraded();
  }
  function store() {
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({ trades, untraded, round: $("mb-round").value })); } catch (e) {}
  }
  function msg(t) { $("mb-msg").textContent = t; }

  // The deck's values, so a typo is caught even before the lists are filled in.
  const knownB = () => new Set(data.buyers), knownS = () => new Set(data.sellers);

  function add() {
    const r = round(), v = +$("mb-b").value, c = +$("mb-s").value, p = +$("mb-p").value;
    if ($("mb-b").value === "" || !knownB().has(v)) return msg(`No buyer card has the value $${v}.`);
    if ($("mb-s").value === "" || !knownS().has(c)) return msg(`No seller card has the cost $${c}.`);
    if ($("mb-p").value === "" || p < 0) return msg("Enter the price.");
    if (p > v) return msg(`Not allowed: the buyer's value is $${v}, below $${p}.`);
    if (p < c) return msg(`Not allowed: the seller's cost is $${c}, above $${p}.`);
    const now = cur();
    trades.push({ round: r, v, c, p });
    const money = (n) => "$" + (Math.round(n * 100) / 100).toString();
    msg(`Sold at ${money(p)}. Buyer's gain ${money(v - p)}, seller's gain ${money(p - c)}.`);
    $("mb-b").value = ""; $("mb-s").value = ""; $("mb-p").value = ""; $("mb-b").focus();
    store(); render();
  }

  function schedule() {
    const d = dealtB().slice().sort((a, b) => b - a);
    const s = dealtS().slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
    // Q: matches of the k-th highest buyer with the k-th lowest seller while
    // the buyer's value exceeds the seller's cost. The clearing range runs
    // from the higher of (last trading seller's cost, first left-out buyer's
    // value) to the lower of (last trading buyer's value, first left-out
    // seller's cost): any price there makes exactly Q trades worthwhile.
    let q = 0, surplus = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < Math.min(d.length, s.length); k++) if (d[k] > s[k]) { q++; surplus += d[k] - s[k]; }
    let prices = [];
    if (q > 0) {
      const lo = Math.max(s[q - 1], q < d.length ? d[q] : 0);
      const hi = Math.min(d[q - 1], q < s.length ? s[q] : data.top);
      prices = lo <= hi ? [lo, hi] : [lo];
    }
    return { d, s, prices, q, surplus };
  }

  const SHAPES = ["circle", "square", "triangle", "diamond", "circle", "square"];
  // Outcome chart: supply and demand for the cards in play, the selected
  // round's trades as numbered dots in order, and each round's average
  // price as a dashed line.
  function chart(target, capId, sch, now, r, band) {
    const n = Math.max(sch ? Math.max(sch.d.length, sch.s.length) : 0, now.length, 10);
    const top = data.top, W = 960, H = 560, ml = 90, mr = 150, mt = 30, mb = 80;
    const x = (k) => ml + (k / (n + 0.5)) * (W - ml - mr);
    const y = (p) => mt + (1 - p / top) * (H - mt - mb);
    const curve = (h, color) => `<polyline fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" points="${h.map((v, k) => `${x(k + 1)},${y(v)}`).join(" ")}"/>` +
      h.map((v, k) => `<circle cx="${x(k + 1)}" cy="${y(v)}" r="4.5" fill="#fff" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2.5"/>`).join("");
    let g = "";
    for (let p = 0; p <= top; p += 1) {
      const major = p % data.tick === 0;
      g += `<line x1="${ml}" y1="${y(p)}" x2="${W - mr}" y2="${y(p)}" stroke="${major ? "#c8c8c8" : "#e2e2e2"}"/>`;
      g += `<text x="${ml - 12}" y="${y(p) + 6}" text-anchor="end" font-size="17">$${p}</text>`;
    }
    for (let k = 0; k <= n; k += 1) {
      g += `<line x1="${x(k)}" y1="${mt}" x2="${x(k)}" y2="${H - mb}" stroke="#e2e2e2"/>`;
      g += `<text x="${x(k)}" y="${H - mb + 28}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17">${k}</text>`;
    }
    g += `<line x1="${ml}" y1="${H - mb}" x2="${W - mr}" y2="${H - mb}" stroke="#595a5b" stroke-width="2"/>`;
    g += `<line x1="${ml}" y1="${mt}" x2="${ml}" y2="${H - mb}" stroke="#595a5b" stroke-width="2"/>`;
    g += `<text x="${(ml + W - mr) / 2}" y="${H - 14}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20">${data.plural}</text>`;
    g += `<text transform="translate(26 ${(mt + H - mb) / 2}) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20">Price</text>`;
    if (sch && sch.d.length && sch.s.length) {
      if (sch.prices.length) {
        const yb = y(sch.prices[sch.prices.length - 1]), hb = Math.max(2, y(sch.prices[0]) - yb);
        g += `<rect x="${ml}" y="${yb}" width="${W - ml - mr}" height="${hb}" fill="#BF5700" opacity="0.12"/>`;
        g += `<text x="${ml + 10}" y="${yb + 16}" text-anchor="start" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#8f4100">market-clearing price: ${band}</text>`;
      }
      g += `<line x1="${x(sch.q)}" y1="${y(0)}" x2="${x(sch.q)}" y2="${y(sch.prices[0] || 0)}" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/>`;
      g += curve(sch.d, "#0072B2") + curve(sch.s, "#8f4100");
      g += `<text x="${x(sch.d.length) + 4}" y="${y(sch.d[sch.d.length - 1]) + 32}" text-anchor="end" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#005f94">Demand</text>`;
      g += `<text x="${x(sch.s.length) + 4}" y="${y(sch.s[sch.s.length - 1]) - 18}" text-anchor="end" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#8f4100">Supply</text>`;
    }
    // Each round's average price, as a dashed line with a label in the right margin.
    const rounds = [...new Set(trades.map((t) => t.round))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const avgs = rounds.map((rr) => { const l = trades.filter((t) => t.round === rr); return [rr, l.reduce((a, t) => a + t.p, 0) / l.length]; });
    let lastLabelY = -99;
    avgs.forEach(([rr, a]) => {
      g += `<line x1="${ml}" y1="${y(a)}" x2="${W - mr}" y2="${y(a)}" stroke="#595a5b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 5"/>`;
      let ly = y(a); if (lastLabelY > 0 && ly - lastLabelY < 20) ly = lastLabelY + 20; lastLabelY = ly;
      g += `<line x1="${W - mr}" y1="${y(a)}" x2="${W - mr + 8}" y2="${ly}" stroke="#595a5b" stroke-width="1"/>`;
      g += `<text x="${W - mr + 12}" y="${ly + 5}" text-anchor="start" font-size="15" fill="#393A3B">Round ${rr} avg $${(Math.round(a * 100) / 100)}</text>`;
    });
    $(target).innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Supply and demand for the cards in play, clearing at ${band}, Q = ${sch ? sch.q : 0}, with each round's average price as a dashed line">${g}</svg>`;
    $(capId).textContent = "";
  }

  // Live view: each round's trade prices in order, one column per round,
  // numbered dots joined by a thin line, on a shared price axis.
  function pricepath(r) {
    // Dots only, on a price axis trimmed to the cards' range.
    const list = trades.filter((t) => t.round === r);
    const lo = Math.max(0, Math.min(...data.sellers) - 1), hi = Math.max(...data.buyers) + 1;
    const W = 960, H = 330, ml = 70, mr = 30, mt = 20, mb = 60;
    const y = (p) => mt + (1 - (p - lo) / (hi - lo)) * (H - mt - mb);
    let g = "";
    for (let p = lo; p <= hi; p += 1) {
      g += `<line x1="${ml}" y1="${y(p)}" x2="${W - mr}" y2="${y(p)}" stroke="#e2e2e2"/>`;
      g += `<text x="${ml - 12}" y="${y(p) + 6}" text-anchor="end" font-size="18">$${p}</text>`;
    }
    g += `<line x1="${ml}" y1="${mt}" x2="${ml}" y2="${H - mb}" stroke="#595a5b" stroke-width="2"/>`;
    g += `<line x1="${ml}" y1="${H - mb}" x2="${W - mr}" y2="${H - mb}" stroke="#595a5b" stroke-width="2"/>`;
    g += `<text transform="translate(22 ${(mt + H - mb) / 2}) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19">Price</text>`;
    g += `<text x="${(ml + W - mr) / 2}" y="${H - 14}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19">Round ${r} trades, in order</text>`;
    const most = Math.max(8, list.length);
    const px = (k) => ml + ((k + 1) / (most + 1)) * (W - ml - mr);
    if (list.length) {
      const avg = list.reduce((a, t) => a + t.p, 0) / list.length;
      g += `<line x1="${ml}" y1="${y(avg)}" x2="${W - mr}" y2="${y(avg)}" stroke="#BF5700" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>`;
      g += `<text x="${W - mr - 6}" y="${y(avg) - 8}" text-anchor="end" font-size="16" fill="#8f4100">average $${Math.round(avg * 100) / 100}</text>`;
    }
    list.forEach((t, k) => { g += `<circle cx="${px(k)}" cy="${y(t.p)}" r="8" fill="#1a1a1a"/>`; });
    $("mb-svg").innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Round ${r} trade prices in order: ${list.map((t) => "$" + t.p).join(", ") || "none yet"}">${g}</svg>`;
    $("mb-cap").textContent = "";
  }

  function render() {
    const r = round(), now = cur();
    const avg = now.length ? (now.reduce((a, t) => a + t.p, 0) / now.length).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") : "–";
    const tile = ([b, s]) => `<div><b>${b}</b><span>${s}</span></div>`;
    // Live: average price and trade count, and a dot plot of the prices.
    $("mb-summary").innerHTML = [[`${now.length}`, now.length === 1 ? "trade" : "trades"],
      [now.length ? `$${avg}` : "–", "average price"]].map(tile).join("");
    pricepath(r);
    // Debrief: supply and demand from the cards handed out.
    const sch = schedule();
    $("mb-dealt-note").textContent = `Round ${r}: ${now.length} trades, ${untradedB().length} buyers and ${untradedS().length} sellers untraded, so ${sch.d.length} buyer cards and ${sch.s.length} seller cards in play.`;
    const band = sch.prices.length ? (sch.prices[0] === sch.prices[sch.prices.length - 1] ? `$${sch.prices[0]}` : `$${sch.prices[0]} to $${sch.prices[sch.prices.length - 1]}`) : "–";
    const gains = now.reduce((a, t) => a + (t.v - t.c), 0);
    // Per-round statistics: trades, average price, gains captured of the most possible.
    const played = [...new Set(trades.map((t) => t.round))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const stat = (rr) => {
      const l = trades.filter((t) => t.round === rr);
      const d = l.map((t) => t.v).concat(parse((untraded[rr] || {}).b || "")).sort((p, q) => q - p);
      const s = l.map((t) => t.c).concat(parse((untraded[rr] || {}).s || "")).sort((p, q) => p - q);
      let m = 0; for (let k = 0; k < Math.min(d.length, s.length); k++) if (d[k] > s[k]) m += d[k] - s[k];
      return { n: l.length, avg: l.length ? (l.reduce((a, t) => a + t.p, 0) / l.length) : null, g: l.reduce((a, t) => a + (t.v - t.c), 0), m };
    };
    const money = (n) => "$" + (Math.round(n * 100) / 100);
    const head = played.map((rr) => `<th scope="col">Round ${rr}</th>`).join("");
    const row = (label, f) => `<tr><th scope="row">${label}</th>${played.map((rr) => `<td>${f(stat(rr))}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`;
    $("mb-summary2").innerHTML = played.length ? `<table class="mb-stats"><thead><tr><th scope="col"></th>${head}</tr></thead><tbody>` +
      row("Trades", (s) => s.n) + row("Average price", (s) => s.avg === null ? "–" : money(s.avg)) +
      row("Gains captured", (s) => `$${s.g} of $${s.m}`) + "</tbody></table>" : "";
    chart("mb-svg2", "mb-cap2", sch, now, r, band);
    // The cards in play, ranked: row k is the k-th point on each curve.
    if (!sch.d.length && !sch.s.length) { $("mb-table").innerHTML = ""; return; }
    const K = Math.max(sch.d.length, sch.s.length);
    const rows = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < K; k++) {
      const v = sch.d[k], c = sch.s[k];
      const both = v !== undefined && c !== undefined;
      const ok = both && v > c;
      rows.push(`<tr${k < sch.q ? "" : ' class="mb-out"'}><td>${k + 1}</td><td class="mb-buyer">${v === undefined ? "" : "$" + v}</td><td class="mb-seller">${c === undefined ? "" : "$" + c}</td><td>${both ? (ok ? "$" + (v - c) : "none") : ""}</td></tr>`);
    }
    $("mb-table").innerHTML = `<table><caption>Cards in play, ranked: buyers from the highest value, sellers from the lowest cost. Row ${sch.q} is the last pair that can both gain.</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">#</th><th scope="col" class="mb-buyer">Buyer's value</th><th scope="col" class="mb-seller">Seller's cost</th><th scope="col">Gain if they trade</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.join("")}</tbody></table>`;
  }

  function exportJSON() {
    const out = { label: "Results from class on " + new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "long", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }) + ".",
                  round: $("mb-round").value, trades, untraded };
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(out, null, 1) + "\n"], { type: "application/json" }));
    a.download = "market-results.json"; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }

  function csv() {
    const lines = ["round,trade,price,buyer_value,seller_cost,buyer_earns,seller_earns"];
    const per = {};
    trades.forEach((t) => { per[t.round] = (per[t.round] || 0) + 1; lines.push([t.round, per[t.round], t.p, t.v, t.c, t.v - t.p, t.p - t.c].join(",")); });
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([lines.join("\n") + "\n"], { type: "text/csv" }));
    a.download = "market-trades.csv"; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }

  // Opening the page with #demo loads three sample rounds, for rehearsing the debrief.
  function demo() {
    // 40 students: three full bundles plus the top two cards of a fourth on each side.
    const R = {
      1: [[10, 2, 4], [9, 3, 8], [10, 4, 7], [8, 2, 5], [7, 5, 6], [9, 3, 5], [8, 5, 7], [10, 8, 9], [9, 2, 6], [7, 4, 6], [10, 3, 5], [8, 4, 6]],
      2: [[10, 2, 6], [9, 3, 7], [10, 2, 5], [8, 4, 6], [9, 3, 6], [7, 5, 6], [8, 4, 7], [7, 5, 5], [10, 2, 6], [9, 3, 6], [10, 3, 6], [8, 4, 6], [9, 2, 7]],
      3: [[10, 2, 6], [9, 3, 6], [10, 2, 6], [8, 4, 6], [9, 3, 7], [8, 4, 6], [7, 5, 6], [7, 5, 6], [10, 2, 6], [9, 3, 6], [10, 2, 6], [9, 3, 6], [8, 4, 6], [7, 5, 6]],
    };
    trades = [];
    Object.keys(R).forEach((rr) => R[rr].forEach(([v, c, p]) => trades.push({ round: +rr, v, c, p })));
    untraded = { 1: { b: "9, 7, 4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3", s: "2, 3, 5, 8, 8, 9, 9, 9" },
                 2: { b: "7, 4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3", s: "5, 8, 8, 8, 9, 9, 9" },
                 3: { b: "4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3", s: "8, 8, 8, 9, 9, 9" } };
    $("mb-round").value = "3";
    showUntraded(); store();
    history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname);
  }

  const RESULTS_URL = "market-results.json";   // optional: last class's results, published beside this page
  Promise.all([fetch(DATA_URL).then((res) => res.json()),
               fetch(RESULTS_URL).then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : null)).catch(() => null)]).then(([d, results]) => {
    data = d;
    // Dropdowns hold each side's distinct card values, highest first for buyers, lowest first for sellers.
    const opts = (vals) => vals.map((v) => `<option value="${v}">$${v}</option>`).join("");
    $("mb-b").innerHTML = '<option value="">–</option>' + opts([...new Set(d.buyers)].sort((a, b) => b - a));
    $("mb-s").innerHTML = '<option value="">–</option>' + opts([...new Set(d.sellers)].sort((a, b) => a - b));
    load(results);
    if (location.hash === "#demo") demo();
    $("mb-json").addEventListener("click", exportJSON);
    $("mb-add").addEventListener("click", add);
    $("mb-p").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") add(); });
    $("mb-csv").addEventListener("click", csv);
    $("mb-undo").addEventListener("click", () => { const r = round(); for (let i = trades.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (trades[i].round === r) { trades.splice(i, 1); break; } msg("Removed the last trade."); store(); render(); });
    $("mb-clear-round").addEventListener("click", () => { if (confirm(`Clear all round ${round()} trades?`)) { trades = trades.filter((t) => t.round !== round()); store(); render(); msg(""); } });
    $("mb-clear").addEventListener("click", () => { if (confirm("Clear every trade in every round?")) { trades = []; untraded = {}; showUntraded(); store(); render(); msg(""); $("mb-note").hidden = true; } });
    ["mb-ub", "mb-us"].forEach((id) => $(id).addEventListener("input", () => {
      untraded[round()] = { b: $("mb-ub").value, s: $("mb-us").value }; store(); render(); }));
    $("mb-round").addEventListener("change", () => { showUntraded(); store(); render(); msg(""); });
    render();
  }).catch(() => msg("Could not load the card schedule (market-data.json)."));
})();
</script>
```
